title: 第十九章 千万剑一剑无痕第二十章 不可思议
lines: 一声清啸自老道士身前冲出，往四下蔓延而去。
手中的灵剑不动如山，只有衣袖在寒风中飘拂。
百里问秋脸上的神情瞬间变得凝重，她感受到了老道士身上的一抹杀意。
一声，百花婆婆横剑于身前，先在身下布下三尺世界，然后准备跟对手过招。
剑未出，雪山上的天地灵气便纷纷往她涌来！
如有千百道灵剑，听从她的召唤骤然而来，静静地悬停于她身前的寒风之中，沉默无语。
看在老道士眼里，却是百花婆婆，比纳兰明还要恐怖。
在他身前十丈外的百花婆婆，在身前三尺结成一个形成百剑，千剑的剑阵！
剑阵遮蔽天光，杀气腾腾！
跟纳兰明的那千百道剑不同，纳兰明只是想将他困住。
而眼前这个女人，是要以这千百道灵剑，要他的性命。
他怒了，这里是他的世界，不是百花谷。
在云起道观，他便在身陷千万道灵剑之中，也胜似闲庭散步。
于是老道士挥手身后雪地里，王贤用树枝写下的平安符召唤出来，自厚厚的雪花里缓缓升起。
看在百里问秋眼中，如同老道士周身多了一团淡淡的护体金光。
于是她笑了，心道如此高人也需要金光护体。
跌坐在灶房里的王贤也笑了。
师父拂袖抹去的只是雪地表面的符文，却没有抹去那已经深入冻土中的符意。
嘴角挂着一抹血渍，却嘿嘿笑道。
“平安是福，平平安安，碎碎平安！”
此时的少年，还没有觉醒在凤凰书院那生不如死的记忆。
在王贤心里，今天是伤得最重的一天。
却也是颇为开心的一天，因为他终于在雪地里写下了一道平安符。
他知道，在雪地里完成一道符，可比朱砂在符纸上难上多少倍，而他成功了。
便是被这恶女人一剑斩得吐血，也值了。
寒风中的老道士，静静地握着灵剑。
他没有急着去破开百花婆婆身前的剑阵，他在等，跟纳兰明不同，他不需要聚势。
当他站在这里，便有一股无敌的气势，出现在他的身上。
看在百里问秋的眼里，入眼外，漫天风雪中都是剑，剑气纵横，将这座道观笼罩了起来。
她却无法阻止母亲出手。
她也在等，等着两人过招之后，带着母亲离开这里。
content_en:
A clear roar rushed out from in front of the old Taoist priest and spread in all directions.
The spiritual sword in his hand remained motionless, and only his sleeves fluttered in the cold wind.
The expression on Baili Wenqiu's face instantly became solemn, and she felt a trace of killing intent on the old Taoist priest.
"Zhi!"
With a sound, Granny Baihua stretched her sword in front of her body, first laid a three-foot world under her body, and then prepared to fight with her opponent.
Before the sword came out, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth on the snow-capped mountains rushed towards her!
It was as if there were thousands of spiritual swords that came suddenly in response to her call and hovered quietly in the cold wind in front of her, silent and speechless.
In the eyes of the old Taoist priest, it was Granny Baihua who was even more terrifying than Nalan Ming.
Granny Baihua, who was ten feet away in front of him, formed a sword formation forming a hundred swords and a thousand swords three feet in front of him!
The sword array blocks the sky light, and it is full of murderous intent!
Different from Nalan Ming's thousands of swords, Nalan Ming just wanted to trap him.
And the woman in front of him wanted to kill him with these thousands of spiritual swords.
He was angry. This was his world, not the Valley of Flowers.
At Yunqi Taoist Temple, being immersed in thousands of spiritual swords was better than taking a leisurely stroll in the courtyard.
So the old Taoist priest waved his hand and in the snow behind him, Wang Xian summoned the peace charm written on a tree branch, slowly rising from the thick snowflakes.
In Baili Wenqiu's eyes, it was as if the old Taoist priest had a faint protective golden light all over his body.
So she smiled. Even a person with such a high mind needs golden light to protect her body.
Wang Xian, who fell into the kitchen, also laughed.
The master wiped away only the runes on the surface of the snow with a flick of his sleeve, but did not erase the runes that had penetrated deep into the frozen soil.
There was a trace of blood on the corner of his mouth, but he chuckled.
"Peace is a blessing, peace is peace, peace is peace!"
At this time, the young man has not yet awakened to the memory of life in Phoenix Academy where life was worse than death.
In Wang Xian's heart, today is the most hurtful day.
But it was also a very happy day, because he finally wrote a peace charm in the snow.
He knew that completing a talisman in the snow was many times more difficult than putting cinnabar on the talisman paper, but he succeeded.
Even if he was slashed by this evil woman until he vomited blood, it was worth it.
The old Taoist priest quietly held his spiritual sword in the cold wind.
He was not in a hurry to break the sword formation in front of Granny Baihua. He was waiting. Unlike Nalan Ming, he did not need to gather momentum.
When he stood here, an invincible aura appeared on him.
In Baili Wenqiu's eyes, outside his eyes, the sky was full of swords in the wind and snow, and the sword aura enveloped the Taoist temple.
But she couldn't stop her mother from taking action.
She was also waiting, waiting for the two of them to fight before taking her mother away from here.
title_en: Chapter 19: Thousands of Swords, One Sword Leaves No Trace Chapter 20: Incredible
